name: Annecy Open 2016
information:
The competition is free and open to everyone, it will be held the last week-end of october from 8:00 am to 7:00 pm the saturday and from 8:00 am to 5:30 the sunday.

**The competition is limited to 75 competitors** and will propose the events :

- 2x2x2 (3 rounds)
- 3x3x3 (3 rounds)
- 4x4x4 (3 rounds)
- 5x5x5 (2 rounds)
- 6x6x6 (1 round)
- 7x7x7 (1 round)
- 3x3x3 one handed (2 rounds)
- 3x3x3 blindfolded (2 rounds)
- Pyraminx (2 rounds)
- Skewb (2 rounds)
- Square-1 (2 rounds)
- Megaminx (2 rounds)
- 3x3x3 Multiple Blindfolded (1 attempt)
